code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (pH 6.9, low O2 saturation/PaO2), suggestive of acute respiratory failure. There is mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, monocytosis, and basophilia, with elevated D-dimer, ferritin, and INR, indicating possible systemic inflammation, coagulopathy, and risk of thromboembolic events. These findings are concerning for severe infection (e.g., sepsis, COVID-19) with respiratory compromise and possible DIC. Immediate clinical attention is warranted.
